title: I Won A Rabbit At The Fair (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you win a prize at the Creepyville fair. A tiny white rabbit.
It's the cutest thing you've ever seen. You name it Marshmallow.
The man at the stall smiles too long. "Feed it carrots. Only carrots."
At home, Marshmallow sits on your bed and watches you do homework.
It's adorable. It's also very quiet. Too quiet for a pet.
The next morning, your homework is finished.
Every answer is correct. In handwriting that isn't yours.
You look at Marshmallow. Marshmallow looks at you.
That night, you forget to buy carrots. You give it lettuce.
It doesn't eat. It just keeps staring.
At midnight, you wake up to a soft crunching sound.
Marshmallow is sitting on your desk, eating your pencils. One by one.
It has grown. It's the size of a dog now.
*It swallows the last pencil and says, in a tiny polite voice, "Carrots. Tomorrow. Please."
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
